title: Create a node under a staged scene

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: demo/ open in Godot 4.3+ (mono), addon enabled, bridge running. node_* tools live in the typed-editor group (hidden by default). The setup step activates typed-editor via mcp_tool and stages a disposable copy of a healthy scene under _ValidationSuite/m10-node-create/ — the canonical demo/Scenes/ scene is never mutated in place.

steps.title: Activate typed-editor and stage a disposable scene
Create a uniquely named node in the staged scene
Expected outcomes
items: node_create returns isError: false and NodeData for M10_CreatedNode (type Node2D) owned by the edited scene root.
node_find locates M10_CreatedNode in the edited scene tree (single-node result).
With gate: enforce the mutation reports no new gate errors (or documents that node mutators are a forward-compat gate no-op until the gate flow lands).
The staged scene shows the new node in its tree / marked unsaved.

reset.note: Deletes the staged Validation Suite fixture tree (_ValidationSuite/m10-node-create/). Canonical demo/Scenes/ scenes are untouched; discard the unsaved edited scene without saving.
